title: FundForge outbox event
description: One row of the transactional outbox, written in the same PostgreSQL transaction as the accepted command that produced it, then relayed to Kafka by Debezium. Kafka is downstream only: Postgres stays the authority, and replaying a topic from offset 0 must reproduce the batch features. Money and rates are decimal strings, never floats.

event_id.description: UUIDv5 of room_id|seq|kind|idx. Unique economic identity; consumers deduplicate on it.

room_id.description: Kafka partition key, so each room is totally ordered.

seq.description: Room version of the accepted command that produced this event.

idx.description: Position of this event among the events of one command.

audience.description: Who may see it in play. Seat-facing feature builders read public and that seat only; internal is for audit and anomaly jobs. Never widened downstream.

sim_date.description: Simulated business date when the event became available. Never wall time.

chain_head.description: Command-log hash chain head after seq, for verification.

payload.description: Kind-specific body. Must not contain hidden-truth keys (variant, seed, gen_seed, tape, factors, regime, true_state) unless kind is outcome.
